summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) furnishing an intimation dated September 21, 2026, under Regulation 30 of India's SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations. The disclosure is purely an advance notice that management will participate in an in-person group investor meeting hosted by Nomura in Hyderabad on September 25, 2026, from 11:00 to 14:00 IST. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory terms are stated. This is a routine investor-relations notice, not a special situation; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle.
